items.label: ♥Material
items.value: The latest long sleeve shirt from Jescakoo is super soft, lightweight, flowy, comfortable and suitable for wearing all day

items.label: ♥Features
items.value: Classic v neck design, Color block/Solid color. loose fit style, basic tunic tops for leggings,length enough to cover your hips,hide your belly.

items.label: ♥All Match
items.value: This tunic sweater is easy to dress up or dress down, and nice to style with a necklace for a chic and elegant look. Front-tucked to wear with dress pants to work, it's still cute, and casual to pair with leggings/ jeans/ shorts, etc.

items.label: ♥Occasion
items.value: Daily casual wear, around home, office work clothes, vacation, holiday outfits, pregnancy, OOTD, errands, shopping, going out, etc. It's a must-have tunic top for transitional weather.

items.label: ♥Care Instructions
items.value: If you notice wrinkles due to vacuum packaging, a simple wash or ironing will work wonders in refreshing the tops. Machine or Hand Wash with Cold Water/Hang or Line Dry/No Bleach/No Dry Clean/Warm iron if needed.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: Business Casual, Daily, Fall Fashion 2025, Vacation, Winter
